name: Matthias
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament

points: And they appointed two, Joseph called Barsabas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias: so they took two men. And it came down to these two. These two men meet the criteria, but it's only one that we can choose.
and the lot fell upon Matthias; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles: so what just happened? Matthias was promoted to a bishop.

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
